title: The Kid Who Built a Wheel

lines.text: In this world, this is the most illegal object on Earth.
Because nobody ever invented the wheel. Everything is carried, and carrying is the biggest job on the planet. Half the world are porters.
He put four under a box, and moved his whole house in one trip. A job that takes ten porters, done by one kid.
If wheels caught on, half the world would lose their jobs. So by lunch, the porters' guild had a price on his head.
So he did the only thing he could. He rolled.
Straight down the hill, and through the guild boss's ground-floor penthouse window.
The boss looked at the wheel. And bought it. Now he owns the only wheel on Earth, and uses it as a coffee table.
